strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Adds a fixed Rust-owned cargo test verifier under controlled tool execution instead of enabling generic process execution.
Requires ExecuteProcess, rejects caller commands/selectors/environment/timeout fields, and denies modes without process permission before launch.
Records bounded ToolExecution evidence for passed, failed, denied, rejected, timed-out, and spawn-failed cargo test verification without raw output or paths.
Lets headless task.run obtain local replay-safe test evidence before PR review or external CI.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances controlled_workspace_tools with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: verification.cargo_test can run cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked --offline through Rust-owned tool.execute and task.run paths with bounded result evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: cargo_fmt_check verifies formatting only and cargo_check verifies compilation only. Generic process.exec and caller-supplied cargo test remain denied by design.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie still cannot run workspace tests as a runtime-owned verifier and must rely on external CI or unsafe caller shell execution for test evidence.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M27.2 and M28.1 handled recovery/apply continuation and M28 closeout selected the next capability; this phase adds a new fixed verifier execution capability.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase reuses tool.list, tool.execute, task.run, run.events, and existing inspection surfaces.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It extends existing bounded verifier metadata and completion-gate evidence rather than adding a report, digest, readiness, preview, or inspection wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A permitted verifier-mode task can now execute the fixed cargo test verifier; invalid inputs and modes without ExecuteProcess are rejected or denied before launch.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless controllers can obtain replay-safe local test pass/fail evidence under runtime authority before deciding whether to continue, recover, or open a PR.
answers.milestone_progress: Starts M29 by adding the core controlled test verifier vertical slice needed for runtime-owned post-mutation verification.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M29.1 must be reviewed for actual fixed cargo test execution, ExecuteProcess gating, input rejection, bounded metadata, honest safety claims, and absence of generic process execution or wrapper surfaces.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M29.1 changes product/runtime verifier behavior and current phase manifests; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: ToolIntentParser accepts only empty input or check_id=cargo_test and rejects caller commands, selectors, environment, timeout, path, manifest, and unknown fields
tool.execute runs cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked --offline in verifier mode and returns bounded pass/fail/rejected/denied/timeout/spawn metadata
task.run can execute a task-scoped verification.cargo_test intent and require passed evidence before task completion
modes without ExecuteProcess deny without launching a process
ledger and RPC payloads contain no raw stdout/stderr, command string, raw input JSON, environment values, file content, absolute/canonical paths, or target directory path
metadata honestly reports Cargo offline dependency fetch, no OS network isolation, no compile-time sandboxing, test code execution for launched runs, and trusted workspace requirement

tests: runtime client cargo test bounded payload validation

next_phase_candidate_notes: After M29.1 lands, assess whether verification recovery retry can consume cargo_test failures safely. Do not add cargo test report/history/inspection wrappers or generic process execution.
